rules.justification: The message words missing ';' at end of declaration identify a syntax error.
The words reserved keyword and use it as a name identify invalid keyword/name syntax.
The words ambiguous reference and candidates identify a name-resolution failure.
The words dimension or incommensurable identify a quantity/unit mismatch, before the generic type rule.
The words port definition and found partDef identify the wrong kind of referenced definition.
The words cannot bind Natural value and typed by String identify incompatible value types.
The words Bound features and conforming types identify type conformance rather than syntax or name lookup.

rules.messageRegex: must be typed by|must be an? .*(definition|def)\b
